label: At every root-accessible world, each individual existing there other than the selected rigid n can…
paraphrase: At every root-accessible world, each individual existing there other than the selected rigid n can be caused by n at some world accessible from that evaluation world. The causal witness may vary with the recipient. This selected-individual, other-directed, pointwise commitment does not itself assert necessity of n and is an analyst specialization, not the complete source step 6.
